summary: This tutorial covers how to use LibreOffice Impress for creating and presenting slide shows. It explains how to open a presentation file and start a slide show from the main menu or by pressing F5. Navigation through slides can be done using arrow keys or the context menu. Ending a presentation can be done by clicking outside the slide or pressing the Esc key. The tutorial also demonstrates how to use the pen tool for drawing during a presentation. It covers slide transitions, allowing users to change the transition effects between slides. Users can rearrange the order of slides using the Slide Sorter view and apply specific transitions to selected slides. The speed and other properties of transitions can be customized through the Task Pane. Overall, the tutorial provides a comprehensive guide on utilizing various features of LibreOffice Impress for effective presentations.
